extensionDescription.message: Apply browser menus and DOM features supplied by connected Kawaikara Providers.

extensionSetup.message: Kawaikara connected — enable a Provider WebExtension

desktopNotFound.message: Kawaikara was not found. Start or restart the updated app, then click Connect again.

multipleDesktops.message: Multiple Kawaikara profiles are running. Close the others or use a connection code under Advanced.

waitingForApp.message: Waiting for Kawaikara… Allow the browser’s app-opening prompt.

appOffline.message: App not responding · Awaiting connection verification

synchronizedDescription.message: Features and settings are synchronized with your app.

cachedDescription.message: Showing saved settings. The connection has not been verified; the app may be offline or may have disconnected this extension. Its status will update when communication resumes.

connectDescription.message: Use “Use extension” in Kawaikara’s Advanced settings, or connect here.

reviewPermissions.message: Review the sites and capabilities before enabling a Provider. Site access is approved separately in your browser.

noFeatures.message: No browser features supplied by this app.

connectToLoad.message: Connect Kawaikara to load its Providers.

identifyInstallation.message: Use the app location and profile ID to distinguish installations.

actionCancelled.message: Cancelled. An action already sent to the app cannot be recalled.

waitingForLaunch.message: Waiting for Kawaikara. Allow the browser’s app-opening prompt. If nothing opens, click Open Kawaikara or start the paired app manually.

actionDelivered.message: Sent to Kawaikara. You can close this tab.

connectionComplete.message: Connected! Enable Providers in extension settings. You can close this tab.

connectionFailed.message: Could not connect. Click Use extension in Kawaikara again.

startDevelopmentApp.message: Start Kawaikara with pnpm start. For app-initiated pairing, enable development connection on both sides. Connection codes work with either mode.

applyDescription.message: Review your changes, then apply them together in Kawaikara.

developmentConfirm.message: Allow this extension to use development connections? Start the development app with pnpm start.

disconnectPending.message: Disconnected in this browser. Kawaikara will be notified when it is available and this extension is running.
